mapper.select: SELECT date_format(R.CREATED_AT, '%c월 %e일') AS label, count(*) AS value FROM RESERVATION AS R WHERE R.CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{range} DAY) GROUP BY date(R.CREATED_AT) ORDER BY date(R.CREATED_AT)
SELECT ik.name AS label, count(ik.name) AS value FROM SELECTED_KEYWORD AS sk JOIN INTEREST_KEYWORD AS ik ON sk.kwd_no = ik.NO GROUP BY ik.name
SELECT R.inflow AS label, count(*) AS value FROM RESERVATION AS R GROUP BY R.inflow
SELECT R.REGION AS label, count(*) AS value FROM RESERVATION AS R GROUP BY R.REGION
SELECT QP.CATEGORY AS label, count(*) AS value FROM QUESTION_POST AS QP GROUP BY QP.CATEGORY
